quotes.speaker: Egor Demin
quotes.summary_phrase: Egor Demin on the intensity of his NBA off-season training
quotes.excerpt: The off-season have been very intense.
quotes.quote: The off-season have been very intense. A lot of practice, some games, a lot of fun. It's just been cool to do a second summer as an NBA player.

quotes.speaker: Egor Demin
quotes.summary_phrase: Egor Demin on the importance of off-season effort for success
quotes.excerpt: In the summer the effort beats the success where the season to be successful.
quotes.quote: In the summer the effort beats the success where the season to be successful. No matter where I'm going to be and who I'm working out with or how long the workout is or where it is, how can I put as much effort as I can without really worrying about how good it's looking.

quotes.speaker: Egor Demin
quotes.summary_phrase: Egor Demin on working with trainer Zag Gonzalez
quotes.excerpt: I have a lot to say for Zag Gonzalez who's being in the gym with me every day.
quotes.quote: I have a lot to say for Zag Gonzalez who's being in the gym with me every day and this whole entire process of me being able to put as much effort as I can in the workouts that are obviously making me better every single day.

quotes.speaker: Egor Demin
quotes.summary_phrase: Egor Demin on balancing hard work and enjoying the process
quotes.excerpt: The more successful you are, the harder it is and the more stressful it is to work.
quotes.quote: I think the big part of our work has been the more successful you are, the harder it is and the more stressful it is to work on certain things because you're always raise your standard. We are always trying to raise the bar of success. Talking a lot about how to combine those things the right way where you can be giving your best on the court but then also enjoy the presence of each other and the presence of other players on the court who are also helping each other.

quotes.speaker: Egor Demin
quotes.summary_phrase: Egor Demin on the mental and physical aspects of training
quotes.excerpt: It's not just the physical part and just the body, but a lot of it is the mind.
quotes.quote: It's not just the physical part and just the body, but a lot of it is the mind. Enjoy the moment outside of the actual work. When you combine them, I think that's what brings the biggest success you can get out of it.

quotes.speaker: Egor Demin
quotes.summary_phrase: Egor Demin on building chemistry with his teammates
quotes.excerpt: It's been very important for us to be able to learn from each other.
quotes.quote: To my teammates, I think it's been very important for us to be able to learn from each other and find the way how to be impactful for each other. I think we've been pretty successful this summer. We will be even more successful on building relationships before the season starts.
